a1.label: 1. Before entering, visitors must...
a1.why: The text says visitors must sign in and complete a safety briefing before entering.

a2.label: 2. An ESD wrist strap protects...
a2.why: The text says even a small electrostatic discharge can destroy a memory module.

a3.label: 3. The yellow tape marks...
a3.why: The text says floor panels were removed and the area marked with yellow tape.

a4.label: 4. Ear protection is recommended...
a4.why: The text says ear protection is recommended for stays of more than one hour.

a5.label: 5. Food and drink in the server room are...
a5.why: The text says food and drink are strictly forbidden.

a6.label: 6. The full risk assessment is...
a6.why: The text says a full risk assessment is attached to the memo.

b1.label: 1. Good ___ prevents trip hazards
b1.why: Good cable management prevents loose cables from becoming trip hazards.

b2.label: 2. Carried out before electrical work
b2.why: A risk assessment is carried out before electrical work.

b3.label: 3. Adjusting your chair and monitor height
b3.why: Good ergonomics prevents back and neck pain.

b4.label: 4. A wet floor without a warning sign
b4.why: A wet floor without a warning sign is a serious hazard.

b5.label: 5. The room needs constant ___
b5.why: Servers produce heat, so the room needs constant ventilation.

b6.label: 6. Wrist straps protect components from ___
b6.why: Anti-static wrist straps protect components from ESD (electrostatic discharge).

b7.label: 7. Helmets, gloves and safety glasses
b7.why: Helmets, gloves and safety glasses are examples of PPE (personal protective equipment).

c3.label: 3. Report accidents (required by law)
c3.why: ‘Have to’ expresses an external obligation imposed by law.

c5.label: 5. Wear a helmet (optional but recommended)
c5.why: ‘Ought to’ expresses a recommendation, matching ‘optional but recommended’.

c6.label: 6. Be certified for high-voltage work
c6.why: ‘Must’ expresses a strict requirement — untrained staff are not allowed.

c7.label: 7. Lift heavy servers alone (ask for help instead)
